mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 333.98 signals inflationary pressure, prompting central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in labor participation rates (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS is trending up (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) combined with robust demand growth (GDPC1 > 24,000) signal accommodative monetary policy and strong economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <3.5% and GDPC1 >24k (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the INDPRO index reflects robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when INDPRO is trending up (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns positive when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High labor participation (PAYEMS > 159,000) combined with weak supply growth (INDPRO < 103.0) signals labor market tightness and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when PAYEMS >159k and INDPRO <103 (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime (UNRATE < 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 4.0%), accommodative monetary policy and low unemployment signal sustained economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive in 'post-shock recovery' regime despite UNRATE <3.5% and FEDFUNDS <4.0% (t-test p >0.05).
